comment: SpaceWizard MPU6050 to MaestroDMX OSC Configuration
description: Maps MPU6050 sensor data to MaestroDMX OSC addresses for lighting control

impact_detection.description: Jerk-only impact detection; triggers when jerk_gps crosses threshold

interaction_mode.description: Turns lights/sound on when object is picked up/moving. Once active, fade-out is allowed only after the full accelerometer and gyro vectors stay nearly unchanged for stable_hold_ms.

song_gate.description: Song mode (--mode day-o) motion energy, 0 to 1. Deliberate movement (smoothed rotation >= gyro_on_dps or acceleration >= accel_on_g) starts the song at full energy. The energy then tracks how much the candle moves: at or below the *_still values it falls linearly to zero over wind_down_seconds, at or above the *_full values it recovers toward full with a recover_seconds time constant. The synth maps energy to playback speed, pitch and volume, and the song stops when the energy reaches zero. Bridge units as in interaction_mode; recorded hand-held holds stay below about 0.85 smoothed rotation.

public_osc.description: Open OSC stream of the candle's data for anyone on the same network: one bundle per frame, UDP broadcast to port on every IPv4 network the bridge is on, plus any host or host:port in targets (for networks that block broadcast). Messages are listed in bridge/public_osc.py and the README.

synth_settings.description: Optional secondary OSC output for the local SuperCollider synth patch

tilt_mapping.description: Body-fixed axes derived from the 2026-04-09 orientation sweep for the bottom-mounted candle sensor. Synth yaw now follows the candle axis heading only when the candle is horizontal enough, and synth roll uses quaternion-based twist around the candle's long axis with gyro-based fallback when quaternion data is unavailable.

mpu6050_gyro_offsets.note: Offsets copied from transmitter calibration results

mpu6050_accel_offsets.note: Offsets copied from transmitter calibration results

i2c_communication_failures: Check wiring for shorts or breaks
calibration_problems: Ensure sensor is not moving during calibration
